model: exact physical antithetic bounded encounter-flux extension
boundary: first outgoing relative z=+/-L plane; reflected retained

inputs.measure: T preserves every phase cell and uniform phase mass; each original/partner receives Ws/(2Ns), pair mean receives Ws/Ns; all reflected exits and failed weights retained
inputs.theory: For the symmetric free helix the first-Born magnetic-moment work is odd under T with z->-z, so pairing cancels that component. Actual nonlinear observables are solved for both members; no variance or QMC convergence guarantee follows.
inputs.controls: top four weighted paired second moments from each of four main scrambles and alternate; closest four and longest four reflected new partners; sixteen predetermined fresh controls and historical weak boundary control from base experiment; both members at every active step and farther plane
inputs.acceptance: same four sample, six independent-replica, four alternate-partition, two full matched boundary, selected paired and memberwise boundary, paired and memberwise active-step, energy and integrity gates as base; no failed criterion relaxed
inputs.stop_rule: one fixed physical antithetic extension; all original inputs and weights frozen; cap between batches; no outcome-dependent continuation or failure renormalization
inputs.archive: states.npz stores new partners and missing refined original/control states only; global reference ids <base_state_count address immutable base states, ids >=base_state_count address new states at id-base_state_count
inputs.scope: bounded incident-domain empirical quadrature; no omitted-domain moment bound, reverse-complete incident population, physical screening closure, plasma coefficient or lifetime

execution_mode: saved-state receipt replay; no ODE solves

results.memory_scope: Original parent peak unavailable; original worker peaks persisted per state. Recovery parent peak is separately measured.
results.timing_scope: Original exact wall endpoint unavailable; last logged elapsed is a rounded lower bound. Recovery wall is separately measured.
limits: Pairing preserves the exact incoming measure but provides no rigorous error bound or QMC variance guarantee.
Original raw and first-Born control failures remain intact; this is a distinct estimator using new physical trajectories.
No omitted-domain, reverse-complete population, screening closure, physical coefficient or lifetime claim.

original_producer.failure: TypeError: NumPy bool energy gate is not JSON serializable
original_producer.elapsed_scope: Rounded last-batch elapsed is a lower bound; final archive writing and failed serialization occur later. Original exact wall endpoint was not persisted.
original_producer.unavailable_scope: Original in-memory receipt was lost at serialization; unavailable fields are not inferred from the recovery process.

receipt_scope: Numerical gates reconstructed from immutable saved arrays; top-level code/commit/environment identify receipt recovery, not the original ODE execution.
